risks.title: Merger Integration
risks.score_rationale: Major risk related to post-merger integration with Berry Global Group, Inc. completed on April 30, 2025. Significant complexity in merging two large packaging entities.

risks.title: Significant Indebtedness
risks.score_rationale: The company's substantial indebtedness post-merger limits financial flexibility and increases borrowing costs, especially amid rising interest rates.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The packaging sector remains highly competitive globally, affecting volumes and operating margins.

risks.title: Environmental Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Evolving environmental standards, particularly on circularity and decarbonization, require additional investments and may impact profitability.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Increasing reliance on IT systems post-merger heightens exposure to cyberattacks and risks of sensitive data loss.

risks.title: Climate Change Impacts
risks.score_rationale: Physical climate shocks may disrupt production operations and increase energy and raw material supply costs.

risks.title: Raw Material Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to price volatility and shortages of raw materials directly impacts production costs and margin profitability.
